source.title: ProspectMate — historical Dragonflight-compatible addon and personal tracking description
source.author: Cornflower / Mor'Qua

notes: New search angle checked publicly indexed addon-tracked sample exports and source-original per-cast logs instead of re-auditing existing community aggregates. The 2023 Dragonflight-compatible ProspectMate release and 2026 guidance document private per-character conversion tracking, not publicly available independently verified measurements. Original 2022-23 Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage/Writhebark milling posts surfaced again but are already recorded under their original study identities. Do NOT reconstruct actual casts from nominal ore/herb when Resourcefulness refunded reagents; output totals do NOT imply distinct castsWithDrop. No new zero-inclusive per-output histograms, raw skill/rank-conditioned output item IDs, separate study, gold prices or P(hit) were invented.
lookingFor: New source-original Dragonflight ProspectMate/saved-variable export or comparable per-operation record supplying completed Dragonflight Draconium 189143/188658, Serevite 190395/190396/190394, Khaz'gorite 190312/190313/190314, Prismatic 194545, Bubble Poppy 191467 or Saxifrage 191464/191465/191466 observations and exact output IDs, ranks, per-material castsWithDrop, zeros, 0-N histogram, refunds, skill/spec and patch.
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy: 'Draconium Ore prospecting results 2023 spreadsheet completed cast histogram'; result 10i63zb was already indexed; no independently retrievable per-cast event export.

Reddit r/woweconomy: 'Serevite Ore prospected 1000 2023 results'; original 108782r 8000-cast rank-three sample already indexed and includes Resourcefulness savings, not a per-material hit/zero histogram.
Reddit r/woweconomy: 'Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting results'; 10h6ccx firsthand 100 R2 ore and 20 no-diamond casts already indexed, not a new output cohort.
Wowhead: 'Prismatic Ore' (item 194545) result comments: original TheChisel, Hotfor and superbondez material outputs all previously indexed; no novel independent 0/1/2+ log.
Wowhead: 'Bubble Poppy' -> 'Serene Pigment' 198412/198413/198414 source comments identify millable input but do not report original cast/outcome histograms.
Wowhead: 'Saxifrage' -> 'Blazing Pigment' 198418/198419/198420; original Aary rank-two 1700 nominal herbs and 269/1101 pigments already indexed; refunds and exact completed mills unknown.
Wowhead: 'Writhebark' -> 'Flourishing Pigment'; Aary's 968 nominal two-star herbs and 165/657 pigments likewise an existing original, not an independent new dataset.
Blizzard WoW forums: 'Prismatic Ore prospect 5 ore concentration' (Jan 2023 and Jul 2024 reports): confirms five-per-cast usage/bug context, no material output-by-cast numeric ledger.
Warcraft Wiki: 'Prismatic Ore' item/patch/specialization history; deterministic context and beta removal note, no output sample.
CurseForge ProspectMate addon: names Dragonflight 10.1.7 historical builds and per-input personal tracking; page provides software description, not contributor saved-variable processing samples.

Wago Addons ProspectMate versions and usage: 2023 historical release + current source/track description; no independently published original character ledger, rank/skill profile, or zero-inclusive per-output histograms.

GitHub code discovery/web search: 'ProspectMateDB 190396', 'Draconium Ore casts prospect', 'Serevite Ore resourcefulness prospecting' and 'ProspectMate SavedVariables'; no verified original public raw event export.

WoW-Professions Dragon Isles profession guides and Wowhead October 2022 Milling beta wrap-up: process and skill guidance only; beta source is already indexed as unmeasured reference, not a release-era completed-cast study.
